statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring
The ordering clinician documented clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The ordering clinician documented clinical suspicion of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
